author: astraios
quote: This is literally the biggest disconnect between critics and real players in gaming **** one side, you have 152 critics handing out 99/100 out of sheer brand worship and fear of losing early access. On the other side, you have 50,481 actual paying players giving it a 5.6 because they aren't blind to 23 FPS drops, recycled 2013 mission designs, and a lifeless 'museum' open world where 95% of buildings are locked **** Game Awards jury might still hand it GOTY just to save face for the media, but in the eyes of actual gamers, GTA 6 has already gone down as a 5.6 disappointment.
